## Description

Compares pool-implied prices on an automated market maker with order-book prices elsewhere, executing only if edge exceeds fees, gas and slippage.

## Where it may fit

Short-lived dislocations across DEX liquidity pools and centralized or other decentralized venues.

## Vehicles

Crypto arbitrage funds, market makers, DeFi searchers.

## Required data

AMM reserves/curve state, CLOB bids/asks, pool fees, gas/priority fees, block state, slippage and transaction latency.

## Caveats

On-chain transactions may fail or be reordered; account for gas, MEV, pool impact, bridge/custody risk and block inclusion uncertainty.
